name: GSQHalo.cpp
description: GSQHalo.cpp is a llama.cpp fork tuned for ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO quantizations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151), with faster prefill kernels, MTP that fits in memory and a KV cache on SSD. The script installs AMD's ROCm 7.14.1 for gfx1151 in its own prefix, builds the fork from source and serves llama-server's OpenAI-compatible API.

notes.text: GSQHalo.cpp targets AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) only. The container needs /dev/kfd and /dev/dri passed through, which the script sets up when GPU passthrough is enabled.
The install builds from source, which takes about 20 minutes, and so does every update.
The first start downloads ISTA-DASLab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder IQ1_M (about 58 GB) and Unsloth's MTP head (about 4 GB). Follow it with: journalctl -fu gsqhalo
The API listens on all interfaces with no API key. To require one, add --api-key <key> to GSQHALO_ARGS in /opt/gsqhalo/gsqhalo.env.
Change the model or server options in /opt/gsqhalo/gsqhalo.env, then run: systemctl restart gsqhalo
